articles.summary: Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC), the world’s largest provider of healthcare solutions to office-based dental and medical practitioners, announced today that the Company will present at the following investor conferences in November and December: Jefferies Healthcare Conference at the Waldorf Hilton, London on November 17, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Greenwich Time/4:00 a.m. Eastern time. Piper Sandler’s Healthcare Conference at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel, New York on December 1, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time. Henry Schein’s presentations can be heard via live webcast by visiting www.henryschein.com/IRwebcasts . Replays will be available on the Henry Schein website following the presentations. About Henry Schein, Inc. Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC) is a products, services, and technology platforms company for healthcare customers.
